BrochureContent.Content:
The Pinnacle of Charter House Living
Without question the most refined, modern, and high-spec residence within the Charter House complex, Apartment 4 stands in a league of its own. Completely overhauled, redesigned, and upgraded to an exacting luxury standard, this first-floor, dual-aspect home offers an unparalleled turnkey living experience in the vibrant heart of Maynooth.
From the bespoke grey shaker cabinetry, integrated appliances, and designer kitchen to the sleek fully-tiled en-suite shower room, every inch of this home reflects exceptional craftsmanship. Enhanced with triple-glazed windows, modern eco-efficient electric heating, programmable Economy 7 hot water imersion tank and high efficiency LED lighting throughout, Apartment 4 achieves a C2 BER rating—making it the benchmark for energy efficiency and low running costs within the development.

Offered fully turnkey with all high-end furniture, decor, and integrated appliances included in the sale, and being sold with Vacant Possession Status, this property is ideal for discerning owner-occupiers, downsizers seeking uncompromising quality, or investors targeting a prime asset in a premier university town.


Key Features & Highlights
Unmatched Modernity: This top-tier exquisite property presents in absolute showhouse condition.

Vacant Possession: Being sold with Vacant Possession Status—ready for immediate occupation upon completion.

Turnkey Package: Sold fully furnished, including all designer furniture, light fittings, window treatments, and high-spec kitchen appliances.

Superior Energy Performance: C2 BER rating ($188.29 \text{ kWh/m}^2/\text{yr}$) featuring new triple-glazed windows and precision-controlled, eco-efficient electric radiators.

Bespoke Storage Solutions: Custom built-in grey shaker wardrobes with overhead bridge units, under-cabinet feature lighting, and a private, solid-construction external storage shed.

Light-Filled Dual Aspect: Enjoy multi-directional natural light and tranquil views over beautifully landscaped communal gardens.

Central & Secure: Positioned in a private, gated development with coded vehicular and pedestrian gates, intercom entry, and abundant private parking.

Prime Maynooth Location: Just seconds from Maynooth Main Street, Maynooth University, gourmet dining, commuter train/bus hubs, and the picturesque Carton Avenue walk.

Interior Accommodation
Open-Plan Living / Dining / Executive Kitchen (5.87m x 5.51m / 19'3" x 18'1")
A breathtaking open-plan space designed for modern living and entertaining. Finished with premium Urban Oak laminate flooring and decorative ceiling coving throughout.

Executive Kitchen Area: Features a comprehensive range of newly fitted modern grey shaker-style cabinetry, a full-height pantry unit, light oak-effect worktops, and a tiled backsplash. Fully equipped with integrated appliances including an oven, ceramic hob, extractor hood, fridge-freezer, integrated washing machine/dryer, and stainless steel sink.

Lounge & Dining Area: Framed by two large, triple-glazed windows overlooking manicured lawns. Includes access to a private hot press off the hall.

Master Bedroom Suite (3.10m x 2.9m /10'2'' x 9'6'') 
A tranquil retreat bathed in soft natural light from a deep-set rear window.

Finished with Urban Oak flooring and a custom-built, full-wall wardrobe system featuring full-height hanging space, overhead storage cupboards, integrated warm under-cabinet reading lights, and a headboard panel.

Luxury Bathroom (Fully Tiled)
A contemporary, spa-inspired room featuring floor-to-ceiling porcelain tiling.

Equipped with a dark charcoal floating vanity unit with an integrated ceramic wash hand basin, chrome mixer tap, illuminated LED mirror, low-profile WC with a dark timber seat, recessed spotlights, an extractor fan, space heater, and a walk-in shower cubicle with instand access hot water electric shower.

Grounds & Complex Amenities
Gated Security: Electronic vehicular and pedestrian access gates with coded keypad entry and secure intercom connection directly to the apartment.

Landscaped Gardens: Meticulously maintained lawned grounds, mature specimen trees, flowering borders, and quiet stone pathways.

Parking & Private Storage: Generous on-site parking for residents and guests, alongside a dedicated private solid-construction storage shed unique to the apartment.

Location & Lifestyle
Situated on the sought-after Dunboyne Road, Charter House offers direct access to everything Maynooth has to offer:

Transport: Short walk to Maynooth Train Station (Dublin Commuter & Intercity lines) and multiple Dublin Bus / Bus Éireann routes (C1, C2, Airport Express). Immediate access to the M4 motorway.

Amenities: A stone's throw from top-tier restaurants, boutique cafes, bars, Manor Mills Shopping Centre, and Maynooth University campus.

Recreation: Direct access to the famed Carton Avenue walk, Carton House Golf & Spa Resort, local sports clubs, and the Royal Canal Greenway.

Property Details & Outgoings
Price Region: Excess €275,000

Occupancy Status: Vacant Possession

Management Fee: c. €1,500 per annum payable in installments or with 10% discount if paid before 30th April each year.  Management fee for this Apartment is fully paid up until 28th February 2027

BER Number: 100128925 (Class C2)

Viewing: Strictly by appointment with Sole Selling Agent Brid Feely MIPAV (087 205 2649).

Viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the incredible standard finish of this standout apartment.
Strictly by Appointment with the Agent Brid Feely MIPAV on 0872052649
